scope: All source-derived members of 2 overlapping families; excludes rituals and the deferred Phase 9 review list. Every member was recompiled under a detached name/ID. Route assessment is not live execution.

families.title: Creature-dependent degree shifts
families.definition: Save spells whose preamble or rules change the degree of success for some creatures (“get a success instead”, “one degree worse”).

families.title: Unvalued Stunned with a duration
families.definition: Save spells granting Stunned (no value) for a stated number of rounds or minutes.
